Pastel Boutique

Ask for pricing

Houston custom wedding-cake shop. Consultations and tastings are Wednesday and Thursday by appointment, and the shop delivers and sets up.

The wedding page says cakes are priced per serving from design, tiers, and finish, with the full quote given at the consultation. It does print a delivery and setup fee of $55 plus $2 per mile, and it calls the tasting a complimentary $50 value. · Source · checked 2026-10-03 · unpublished

14770 Tomball Parkway, Houston, TX 77086
